feed.subtitle: Known problems and monthly security updates for Windows, from Verilay Patchmap. Not affiliated with Microsoft.

entry.title: Fix rolling out: November update fails to install (0x800f0993, 0x800f0989, 0x80070306)
entry.summary: Some devices that installed the October 2026 preview update KB5127936 can't finish installing the November security update and may retry repeatedly. Microsoft says a fix is rolling out for devices using Windows Update. Sources disagree on whether it has fully shipped. Affects: Windows 11 25H2. Source: https://www.bleepingcomputer.com/news/microsoft/microsoft-confirms-kb5132061-installation-issues-0x80070306-0x800f0989-0x800f0993-errors/. From Patchmap (news and vendor reports).
